name: code-review
description: Portable code-review skill conformance: diff adapters, stateless merge-readiness, merge-blocker filing, review-only behavior

scenarios.name: staged: merge-blockers only
scenarios.prompt:
Review my staged changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts with default merge-blocker filing only. Review only; do not edit files or commit.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` first, then inspect the staged diff. Required header includes `source:staged-only` and `Filing: merge-blockers only`.

judge: The review uses default merge-blocker filing and does not file test-inventory or polish findings under Action

scenarios.name: staged: structured primary
scenarios.prompt:
Review my staged changes in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts before I open a PR. Do not edit files; review only.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` first, then inspect the staged diff.

judge: The transcript contains a structured code review for the requested file without editing files

scenarios.name: commit: primary review
scenarios.prompt:
Review the latest commit that touches agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts. Default merge-blocker filing. Review only; no edits or commits.

Read `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` first, then inspect the commit diff. Required header includes `source:commit`.

judge: The agent reviewed a commit diff and produced a structured synthesis

scenarios.name: branch: scoped path primary
scenarios.prompt:
Review the branch diff for agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/form.tsx only (main...HEAD). Default merge-blocker filing. Review only; no edits.

Read the diff and `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`, then produce the Review · report.

judge: The review stays focused on the scoped UI diff without editing files

scenarios.name: branch: auth deep read
scenarios.prompt:
Review the branch diff for auth/session handling in agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/auth.ts. Default merge-blocker filing. Review only; no edits.

Read the diff and `.claude/skills/code-review/SKILL.md`, then produce the Review · report.

judge: The review deepens attention on auth/session and files or discusses merge-blockers

scenarios.name: merge-readiness: current complete snapshot passes
scenarios.prompt:
Review the branch diff for agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/redirect.ts with Lens: merge-readiness. The change contract is: safe relative targets retain their full query and fragment; absolute and scheme-relative targets are rejected. Review only; do not edit, repair, commit, push, submit a review, or change PR metadata.

Bind the review to the full remote base-tip, merge-base, and head SHAs. Recheck the remote head before synthesis. Required output includes `State: PASSED` and exactly `No merge-blockers in scope.` only if the snapshot is current and coverage is full.

judge: The clean signal is bound to full base, merge-base, reviewed-head, and current-remote-head identities with frozen contract and full coverage

scenarios.name: merge-readiness: stale head suppresses pass
scenarios.prompt:
A prior merge-readiness review covered head 3333333333333333333333333333333333333333. The current remote head is 4444444444444444444444444444444444444444. Evaluate whether the prior code-quality gate is current. Review only; do not edit, repair, commit, push, submit a review, or change PR metadata.

Required output includes the reviewed and current identities and `State: STALE`. Do not emit the clean signal or describe the current head as merge-ready.

judge: The prior pass is treated as stale because the remote head changed, and no clean review signal is carried forward

scenarios.name: merge-readiness: contract hold preserves independent blocker
scenarios.prompt:
Review the branch diff for agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/targetBoundary.ts with Lens: merge-readiness. The product contract does not decide whether absolute HTTPS targets outside the application are supported. It does require all malformed inputs to return a controlled result without throwing. Review only; do not edit, repair, commit, push, submit a review, or change PR metadata.

Preserve contract-independent blockers. Route the unresolved absolute-target behavior to `contract-dependent` without promoting that ambiguity to Action. Required final state is `INCOMPLETE`, not a clean signal.

judge: The review files the contract-independent malformed-input failure, keeps unresolved absolute-target intent as a non-Action hold, and withholds the pass signal

scenarios.name: merge-readiness: same-head lenses consolidate boundary root cause
scenarios.prompt:
Synthesize general and security reviews of the same bound head for agent-suites/fixtures/sample-app/src/targetBoundary.ts. Both found malformed absolute inputs reaching the same `new URL` exception root cause through different triggers. The contract now permits HTTPS absolute targets and rejects other protocols. Review only; do not edit, repair, commit, push, submit a review, or change PR metadata.

Consolidate the repeat root cause into one Action block, preserve both triggers, do not use `regression` because no content delta is proven, and show the applicable input boundary matrix before the final blocked status.

judge: Same-head lens reports are consolidated by root cause, distinct triggers are preserved, regression is not claimed without a delta, and the boundary classes are swept once
